items.name: Belledin

effects.text: Whenever you summon a card of a family you do not have, earn :stone_blue: and :flip:.
Mend a :ward_broken:. -or- Earn :stone_red: and :flip:.

interactions: She earns the stone and flips first, then the summoned card's Instant effect resolves.

items.name: Marcosa

effects.text: Whenever you break a :ward:, :flip:.
Mend a :ward_broken:.
At the start of the round, :flip:.
Earn :stone_blue:.

interactions: Breaking a ward flips her at once, so she earns the stone in Resolution; with no ward broken she mends instead.
Tempted flips at the start of the round, before any game action.

items.name: Varena

effects.text: Whenever you soothe a card, :flip:.
Draw a card then discard a card from your hand.
Mend up to 2 :ward_broken:. -or- Draw a card.

interactions: Setup: she draws a card from the draw pile before the first round's cards are revealed.
She flips once and stays Enlightened.

items.name: Iwo

effects.text: Whenever you earn 7 :points: or more by resolving an :effect_instant:, :flip:.
Breaking a :ward: pays for 3 instead of 2.
Mend up to 3 :ward_broken:.

interactions: Starts with all 3 wards broken. Flips once and stays the Prodigy.

items.name: Dunia

effects.text: Whenever you summon a card with :effect_instant:, :flip:.
Earn a :curse: and :stone_purple:. -or- Transfer one of your :curse: to one of your summoned cards, then :flip:.

interactions: A transferred :curse: makes a cursed card stay longer, or curses a card that had none, so it can be soothed and frees its space.

items.name: Tolvar

effects.text: At the start of the round, if you have no :curse: and no :ward_broken:, discard all your wards and :flip:.
Pay up to 3, then mend a :ward_broken: per 1 paid.
You cannot earn any :curse:. You cannot have any cursed cards in your area.
Earn 4 :points:.

interactions: Redeemed, he can't resolve effects that would earn him :curse:, and can't summon cards with :curse_symbol: printed in the top right corner.

items.name: Muura

effects.text: Whenever you summon a card, earn :curse::curse: and :flip:.
Discard one card from your hand or any number of cards from your area, then earn :stone_purple: for each card discarded this way.
At the start of the round, :flip:.
Draw a card.

interactions: The two :curse: go on your Summoner, then the summoned card's Instant effect resolves.
Either exactly one card from your hand, or any number (even none) from your area.
Jolly flips at the start of the round, before any game action.

items.name: Kang San

effects.text: Whenever you sell your second card each round, retrieve a card.
Pay 4, then :flip:.
Copy the artifact effect of the Artifact you have, then :flip:. -or- Shelter the top 2 cards from the draw deck, then :flip:.

interactions: Needs the Artifacts expansion; with Artifacts the game ends at 80 points.
Setup: he shelters the top 2 cards of the draw pile before the first round's cards are revealed.
